result: For psi_B=c psi_A, real-valued contrasts give rA=Re(c)*exp(-q²T), rB=Re(c)/|c|²*exp(-q²T). Their geometric mean carries |Re(c)|/|c|. Exact recovery with positive contrasts requires c real and positive, not arbitrary complex c.
implication: Stationary cancellation and the existing Gaussian variance-drift simulations are unchanged. General robustness language must state the positive-real multiplicative-factor condition.
